ink-3.note: The lightest value clearing WCAG AA 4.5:1 on the darkest surface it is set against. Enforced by src/data/contrast.test.js.

display.purpose: The page title on the library, dashboard and settings. Newsreader at 400 with negative tracking.

headline.purpose: The single statement on a full-page state: nothing due, a crash, the sign-in heading.

title.purpose: Deck names, folder names, dialog titles (26px in dialogs).

body.purpose: All running prose. Explanatory paragraphs held to roughly 55-65 characters.

label.purpose: Mono uppercase: the kicker above a title, counts, badges, stat captions. Never a sentence.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: The barely-there seat under a deck card at rest.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover on a deck card; anything that should read as picked up.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and dropdown panels, which sit above the page rather than on it.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Entrances and button state. The default curve of the system.

motion.name: ease-in-out-quart
motion.purpose: Motion that leaves and returns, such as the reduced-motion spinner breathing.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: The one page entrance. Applied per page, never per element.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.value: opacity 0 -> 1, translateY(10px) scale(0.97) -> none over 200ms ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: The toast arriving from the foot of the screen.

motion.name: colour-shift
motion.purpose: Hover and focus colour transitions on buttons, cards and menu items.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transition-duration 120ms, animation-duration 160ms, spinner switches from rotation to a 1.2s opacity breathe
motion.purpose: What prefers-reduced-motion collapses the system to. Fewer and gentler, never zero.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The ordinary confirm: ink on paper text.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: Archivo, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.975); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(0.455 0.058 130)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.245 0.012 60)); border-color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.245 0.012 60)); color: var(--color-paper, oklch(0.982 0.006 85)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-ink-2, oklch(0.4 0.011 65)); border-color: var(--color-ink-2, oklch(0.4 0.011 65)); }

components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, oklch(0.888 0.009 85)); background: var(--color-surface, oklch(0.998 0.003 85)); color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.245 0.012 60)); padding: 22px; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px oklch(0.245 0.012 60 / 0.04); transition: border-color 200ms, background-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink-3, oklch(0.525 0.01 70)); background: var(--color-raised, oklch(0.968 0.006 85)); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -14px oklch(0.245 0.012 60 / 0.18), 0 1px 2px oklch(0.245 0.012 60 / 0.05); } .ds-card-strip { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto 0; height: 3px; background: oklch(0.800 0.098 248); } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding-top: 2px; } .ds-kicker { font: 500 10px/1 "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink-3, oklch(0.525 0.01 70)); } .ds-badge { border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, oklch(0.888 0.009 85)); background: var(--color-raised, oklch(0.968 0.006 85)); color: var(--color-ink-2, oklch(0.4 0.011 65)); padding: 5px 8px; font: 500 10px/1 "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font: 400 23px/1.2 Newsreader, Georgia, serif; } .ds-card-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font: 500 10px/1 "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--color-ink-3, oklch(0.525 0.01 70)); } .ds-due { color: var(--color-accent, oklch(0.455 0.058 130)); } .ds-meter { height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-raised, oklch(0.968 0.006 85)); overflow: hidden; } .ds-meter span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 2px; background: oklch(0.800 0.098 248); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Mono uppercase label over a hairline field; focus moves the border to Library Olive, with no glow.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; } .ds-field-label { letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-field-label em { font-style: normal; color: var(--color-accent, oklch(0.455 0.058 130)); } .ds-input { border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, oklch(0.888 0.009 85)); background: var(--color-paper, oklch(0.982 0.006 85)); color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.245 0.012 60)); font: 400 15px/1.55 Archivo, Helvetica, sans-serif; padding: 11px 12px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-ink-3, oklch(0.525 0.01 70)) 70%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-accent, oklch(0.455 0.058 130)); }

narrative.overview:
Gunit looks like a library desk, not a study app. Warm paper, a serif that belongs to a book, generous margins, and one green that behaves more like a second ink than a colour. The reader brings the effort; the room stays calm and gets out of the way. Everything on screen is either their material or a plain statement about it.

The system is calm, editorial and unhurried. Hierarchy is made with type and space before it is made with colour or weight: a serif heading against mono labels and a quiet sans body, on a surface that barely lifts off the page. Density is low where the reader is deciding and lowest of all where they are concentrating, which drop the navigation entirely.

The deliberate anti-reference is the gamified study app. No confetti, no badges, no streak pressure, no mascot supervising every screen. Gunit has a mascot and uses it in eight places on purpose, and nowhere near a card being studied. Encouragement is not the product; the schedule is.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and ink, never white and black
One accent, used for progress and correctness only
Serif headings, sans body, mono labels — three families doing three jobs
Flat at rest; a shadow is a response, not a decoration
Hairline borders (1px) as the main separator
Every screen readable at 375px, with the navigation moving to the thumb

rules.name: The Second Ink Rule
rules.body: Library Olive is not decoration. If a green element does not mean progress, correct or due, it is the wrong colour — use ink.

rules.name: The Warm Field Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the neutral field is pure. Every paper tone carries hue 85 and every ink carries hue 60-70; #fff and #000 appear nowhere.

rules.name: The Measured Grey Rule
rules.body: ink-3 is the floor for text. It sits at 0.525 lightness because that is the lightest value clearing 4.5:1 on the darkest surface it is ever set against, and src/data/contrast.test.js fails the build if it drifts. Nothing lighter is allowed to carry words.

rules.name: The Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Serif names things, sans explains them, mono counts them. A number that can be counted is set in mono; a sentence never is.

rules.name: The Unbolded Heading Rule
rules.body: Serif headings stay at 400. Emphasis comes from size, space and the negative tracking, never from weight.

rules.name: The Thumb Rule
rules.body: Below 640px, primary navigation belongs at the bottom of the screen and every target is at least 44px.

rules.name: The No Sideways Scroll Rule
rules.body: Nothing scrolls horizontally at 375px. New layouts must not introduce a fixed width wider than the screen.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: A shadow must answer something — hover, focus, or a layer genuinely above the page. Ambient shadow on a static surface is decoration and is not used.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: 1px borders separate things. A border thicker than 1px is reserved for a deck's accent strip and the review screen's rating row.

dos: Do use Library Olive only for progress, correctness and due counts — the Second Ink Rule.
Do set every named thing in Newsreader at weight 400, and let size and -0.02em tracking carry the emphasis.
Do put counts, badges and kickers in IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 10-11px, tracking 0.12-0.14em.
Do separate with 1px hairlines in line before reaching for a shadow.
Do keep text at or above ink-3; the contrast test reads src/index.css directly and fails the build on drift.
Do give every dialog a real h2 title and a focus trap that returns focus where it came from.
Do design the 375px view at the same time as the desktop one; navigation moves to the bottom there.
Do state plainly what a destructive action will and will not remove, in the dialog body.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue. A new colour means a new meaning; there is one.
Don't put ambient shadow on a resting surface, or a zero-offset coloured halo anywhere.
Don't bold a serif heading, or set body copy in the mono face.
Don't use pure white or pure black — every neutral is warm-tinted in light, cool-tinted in dark.
Don't celebrate ordinary actions: no confetti, no badges, no streak pressure, no mascot beside a card being studied.
Don't let the mascot appear more than once on a screen, or carry the word Gunit — the wordmark is the brand mark.
Don't introduce a thick coloured border on a rounded card; the one exception is the deck card's 3px top strip.
Don't animate without a reason: motion is a 200ms ease-out entrance or a 150ms colour transition, and it degrades under prefers-reduced-motion.
